10088|0e051c59.name: Xao'tsu
10088|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

15309|d11310f6.name: Spoops
15309|d11310f6.text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|ae78a458.name: Koma
3318|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3352|fd7e1800.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|fd7e1800.text: I have much knowledge to impress upon you, $c. You must learn to hunt with honor.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

8496|944c29ff.name: Liv Rizzlefix
8496|944c29ff.text:
Hiya! This workshop isn't mine, no! But one day after I finish training I am going to be an inventor, just like my hero, Marvon Rivetseeker.

You've never heard of him? Well it just so happens that he left quite some time ago to study some ancient troll ruins he kept talking about. He left in a zeppelin... not quite sure about where exactly he went...

Tanarasin? Tenkeris? Taneranisany?

<Liv shakes her head.>

No, that's not it...

1060-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
1060-accept.text:
You've done so well for me, $N. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
1060-accept.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1061-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1061-complete.text: Ah, a $c.  Very good.  We will need your skills to deal with these plunderers!
1061-complete.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1062-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-accept.text:
The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the Stonetalon Mountains, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest.  The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage.  We must stop the Venture Company!

Head northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag.  You will find the goblins and their servants at work -- show them the Horde will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon.  Show them in the language they best understand...

Violence.
1062-accept.title: Goblin Invaders

235-accept.name: Warcaller Gorlach
235-accept.text:
Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
235-accept.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

3281-complete.name: Gazrog
3281-complete.text:
Aha!  So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair.  It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver.  Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

Thank you, $N.  Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
3281-complete.title: Stolen Silver

3923-complete.name: Rilli Greasygob
3923-complete.text:
What's this?  Why, it's a samophlange!  Where did you get this thing?  Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the Barrens?

You must be very brave, or very stupid.
3923-complete.title: Rilli Greasygob

3923-progress.name: Rilli Greasygob
3923-progress.text: Mind your head!  I don't want it to get in the way of my work!
3923-progress.title: Rilli Greasygob

3924-accept.name: Rilli Greasygob
3924-accept.text:
I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first.  When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted.  I wasn't one of the trusted few...

Boss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern Barrens.  Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.
3924-accept.title: Samophlange Manual

5042-complete.name: Mangletooth
5042-complete.text:
If only Mangletooth were free to see you decimate those who betrayed him! <snort>

I thank you for destroying more of the Bristleback by gathering these shards. Please, continue to do so, and I will continue to aid you. <snort>
5042-complete.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-complete.name: Mangletooth
5043-complete.text:
May your aim be unerring, and the mark of your weapon be true, $r.

Agamaggan's spirit is with you. Return <snort> to me if you wish. Mangletooth will bless you again if the great boar god deems me worthy. <snort>
5043-complete.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5044-complete.name: Mangletooth
5044-complete.text:
Your enemies should fear you even more, $r. <snort>

Tell Mangletooth tales of your cunning in battle when next we meet--be it in this life, or the next. <snort>
5044-complete.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5045-complete.name: Mangletooth
5045-complete.text:
Our greatest warriors, and our greatest <snort> shamans would envy your will, $r.

Defeat more of the Bristlebacks knowing that they cannot stop you! <snort>
5045-complete.title: Rising Spirit

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-accept.name: Mangletooth
5052-accept.text:
Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort>

I know the secrets of that magic.

Bring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>
5052-accept.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

5052-complete.name: Mangletooth
5052-complete.text:
Ah, you do understand. <snort> My words were not lost on your ears, $r. Mangletooth may be caged, but no cage can stop Agamaggan's power! <snort>

The touch of the shard, the feel of it... it has been a long time, $r.

Do you know what it is like? To have your power severed from you?

But, that is a tale for another time. I promised you information. I promised you Agamaggan's power. My people turned their backs on Mangletooth. Now, I lose you upon them. <snort>
5052-complete.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

6548-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6548-accept.text:
The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.

$N, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
6548-accept.title: Avenge My Village

6548-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6548-complete.text: $N, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
6548-complete.title: Avenge My Village

6629-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-accept.text:
$N, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.

You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
6629-accept.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

8312-accept.name: Spoops
8312-accept.text:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8312-accept.title: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!

8359-accept.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
8359-accept.text:
That's an... interesting costume you have on.  Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!

Let's see... you look so strong and buff in that... costume... let's see you flex!  Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong woman!

When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Orgrimmar Nougat.  It's a great Hallow's End treat.
8359-accept.title: Flexing for Nougat

8359-complete.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
8359-complete.text:
You are truly mighty, haha!  Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport.  Here's your candy.

Happy Hallow's End, $N!
8359-complete.title: Flexing for Nougat

850-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-accept.text:
The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years.  And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat.  Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them.  Rallying them.

To preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.

Bring me the head of Barak Kodobane.  He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.

Defeat him, then return to me.
850-accept.title: Kolkar Leaders

850-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead.  And those are the most dangerous.

Barak was such a centaur.  It is good that he is dead.
850-complete.title: Kolkar Leaders

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

851-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
851-accept.text:
The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find.  But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  It may be possible to draw him to you.

Travel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent.  It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm.  And Verog will come.

Bring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.
851-accept.title: Verog the Dervish

855-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
855-accept.text:
The Kolkar are a threat to the Horde's claims in the Barrens; we must reduce the numbers of their troops.  And so, I have a bounty task for you.

While in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers.  Return when you have a heap of bracers and the Horde will reward you well.
855-accept.title: Centaur Bracers

855-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
855-complete.text:
Nicely done.  I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $N.  If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.

But I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.

Unfortunate...for them.
855-complete.title: Centaur Bracers

876-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-complete.text: HA! Well done, $N! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
876-complete.title: Serena Bloodfeather

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

877-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-complete.text:
Your findings are amazing!  The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead.  Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!

We must study this more...
877-complete.title: The Stagnant Oasis

878-complete.name: Mangletooth
878-complete.text:
Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally <snort> the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, $r. That is how I should feel, but that <snort> is not the case.

You aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!

I aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!
878-complete.title: Tribes at War

879-accept.name: Mangletooth
879-accept.text:
Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, $r. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, $r, like they have killed me.
879-accept.title: Betrayal from Within

880-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-accept.text:
Your findings are incredible, $N.  These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source.  Or perhaps an inside one.

I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.

Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases.  Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
880-accept.title: Altered Beings

888-complete.name: Gazlowe
888-complete.text: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, $N. You know, I could use a $r like you to help out with my operation here. If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!
888-complete.title: Stolen Booty

889-complete.name: Mangletooth
889-complete.text: Good. Go with Agamaggan's spirit as your guide, $r. Return to me if you desire more of Agamaggan's magics.
889-complete.title: Spirit of the Wind

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

891-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-complete.text:
Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, $N.

Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
891-complete.title: The Guns of Northwatch

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

97246-accept.name: Thatog
97246-accept.text:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246-accept.title: Meal Appeal
